children: Recent pledges by U.K. Prime Minister Andy Burnham and Treasury Chief John Healey that they will maintain fiscal discipline could support the performance of U.K. government bonds, RBC Capital Markets strategists say in a note. Healey, in a speech this week, reiterated the government's commitment to fiscal responsibility, easing investors' concerns ahead of the budget on October 28, the strategists say. The U.K. sells January 2056 gilts via syndication on Tuesday, which could test demand for U.K. government debt. "This backdrop should be supportive for demand at [Tuesday's] syndication," they say. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
